Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activity rows against human single-protein target CHEMBL1163125 (Bromodomain-containing protein 4). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, join target_dictionary on tid, and join compound_structures on molregno. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL1163125, target_type SINGLE PROTEIN, tax_id 9606, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and pchembl_value not null. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id.
